meta.title: Medoro — Find the right doctor, anywhere in Azerbaijan
meta.description: Medoro matches you with verified doctors by specialty, location and real patient reviews, then lets you book, message and manage records for your whole family. Coming soon to iOS and Android.

hero.eyebrow: Coming soon to iOS & Android — all over Azerbaijan
hero.title: Find the right doctor, wherever you are in Azerbaijan
hero.subtitle: Medoro matches you with verified doctors by specialty, location and real patient reviews — then lets you book, message and manage records for your whole family, in one app.

bookingDemo.pickDateSubtitle: Available time slots will appear here

problem.title: Finding a doctor you can trust still takes too much guesswork.
problem.body: Most people rely on word of mouth, WhatsApp groups and guesswork to find a doctor — with no reliable way to compare trust, fit or real availability, especially outside Baku.

cards.title: Word of mouth only
cards.body: Recommendations end where your contact list does, and they rarely tell you who's actually free this week.

cards.title: Nothing to compare
cards.body: Reviews, prices and real availability live in different places, if they exist online at all.

cards.title: Baku-only options
cards.body: Most directories stop at the capital, leaving patients in every other city to figure it out alone.

how.title: Your visit, matched to what you actually need.

steps.label: Search
steps.title: Tell us what you need
steps.body: Pick a specialty or describe your symptom, then filter by location, language or availability.

steps.label: Match
steps.title: Match instantly
steps.body: Compare verified doctors by distance, rating and open slots — no endless scrolling required.

steps.label: Book
steps.title: Book, message & track
steps.body: Confirm your appointment, message your doctor directly, and keep every visit and record in one place.

specialties.title: Every specialty. One search.
specialties.subtitle: Pick a specialty to see what's waiting for you at launch.
specialties.detailBody: Specialists in this field will be on Medoro from launch day. Match by distance, availability and verified reviews right inside the app.

why.title: Rebuilding healthcare access around the one thing that matters: trust.

cards.title: Verified, licensed doctors
cards.body: Every doctor submits their medical license and credentials for manual review before they ever appear in search.

cards.title: Real reviews only
cards.body: Ratings come only from patients who completed an actual visit — no pay-to-rank, no fake reviews.

cards.title: Built for the whole family
cards.body: Manage appointments, records and reminders for your parents, kids or partner from a single account.

cards.title: All of Azerbaijan
cards.body: Not just Baku — search and book doctors across 75+ cities and regions nationwide, in your own language.

providers.title: Built for the people who provide care — solo or as a clinic.

forDoctors.label: Independent doctors
forDoctors.title: Every patient deserves the right to choose their doctor. Help give them that.
forDoctors.body: List your practice on Medoro with a simple flat subscription — no commission on every booking. Manage your schedule, workplaces and patient messages from one dashboard.

forHospitals.label: Hospitals & clinics
forHospitals.title: One dashboard for your clinic's entire doctor roster.
forHospitals.body: Invite your doctors, manage their working hours across every location, and see a live view of your clinic's schedule — without ever seeing a patient's identity or medical notes. If a doctor moves on, their own schedule and history stay fully intact. Seat-based plans start at 15 doctors.

features.title: Invite your roster
features.body: Search Medoro's doctor directory and invite them to join your clinic — no manual data entry.

features.title: Centralized hours
features.body: Set and adjust working hours for every doctor across all your locations from one place.

features.title: Privacy-safe overview
features.body: See your clinic's appointment volume and schedule — patient identities and medical notes stay with the doctor.

forHospitals.pricingNote: Klinika — 299.99 AZN/mo for up to 15 doctors · Klinika Plus — 599.99 AZN/mo for up to 60 doctors + advanced stats

items.a: Medoro is Azerbaijan's doctor search and appointment platform. Search by specialty or symptom, match with a verified doctor near you, and book in seconds — in your language.
Yes. Searching, booking and messaging doctors is completely free for patients. Doctors join through a simple subscription plan.
Every doctor submits their medical license and credentials, which our team reviews manually before their profile goes live.
Only patients who completed a visit can leave a review, and doctors cannot pay to rank higher — there's no way to fake it.
We're finishing verification and onboarding doctors right now. Join the waitlist and we'll email you the moment Medoro is live.

items.q: Can hospitals and clinics join Medoro?
items.a: Yes. Hospitals and clinics get their own dashboard to invite doctors, manage their schedules across locations, and see appointment volume — without access to patient details. Plans start at 15 doctor seats.

footer.tagline: Your health, simplified. The right doctor in Azerbaijan, in seconds.
footer.legalNote: By joining the waitlist you agree to be contacted about the Medoro launch. No spam, ever.
